trustRules.independence: ORF and Rólunk.at are external publishers and should be treated as corroborating sources, not as BMI-controlled claims.
trustRules.currentness: Press articles are historical evidence at their publication date. Current schedules, prices, enrollment status and organizers must be checked against live official BMI sources.
trustRules.measurement: Participation figures quoted by a press article apply only to the event or scope described by that article and must not be generalized to the full BMI ecosystem.
